Ledgebrook | Engineering, Product & Data | REMOTE (US, Canada, Poland; eligibility varies by role) | https://www.ledgebrook.com/careers

Hi HN, I'm Nathan, CTO at Ledgebrook. We're a Series D tech-enabled insurance company building technology for our internal user base. Our engineers work directly with other departments, so they see the impact of each product release firsthand.

We're hiring for the following remote roles:

Director of Engineering (US or Canada)

Staff Engineer (US or Canada)

Full Stack Engineer (US, Canada, or POland)

Sr Platform Engineer (AWS) (US or Canada)

Principal Data Engineer (US, Canada or Poland)

Product Manager - Underwriting Operations (Poland)

We value clear ownership, direct communication, and giving people room to get things done without micromanagement. Employees share in the company's success through ownership.

Full descriptions and applications: https://www.ledgebrook.com/careers

Questions: hiring@ledgebrook.com
